newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines extends one-day reverse repo offering.
newsitem.headline: Philippines extends one-day reverse repo offering.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Wednesday it had extended the offering of its one-day reverse repos to 3:00 p.m. (0700 GMT) from the original closing time of noon (0400 GMT)

The one-day reverse repos, which carry a 24 percent interest rate, were offered at around 9:00 a.m. (0100 GMT) to curb the rapid weakening of the peso against the dollar following a fresh attack on the Thai baht.
